problem.title: Graph (adjacency matrix)
problem.normalized_statement: Implement an undirected Graph class backed by an adjacency matrix, constructed from a vertex list and an edge list, supporting has_edge and get_vertices queries.

constraints.raw: Vertices are hashable and unique. Edges are undirected: if (u,v) is present, so is (v,u). Invalid edges referencing unknown vertices are ignored.

test_cases.description: query a pair of vertices with no edge between them
self-loop edge is allowed and queryable
querying has_edge with a vertex not in the graph should not crash
